defect_candidates.nature: Array boolean ambiguity with multi-element numpy arrays on val.get('data') or val.get('value'); single-element zeros falsy fallback.

defect_candidates.nature: R/S backend requires sample length >= 100, raising unhandled exception when window < 100.
